FRIERENMOD-ORIGINAL_MUSIC.title: Frieren Anime BGM Selection
FRIERENMOD-ORIGINAL_MUSIC.hover.desc: Play selected Frieren anime BGM for events, battles, bosses, elites, shops and defeat. Disable to restore StS2 music.
FRIERENMOD-ACHIEVEMENTS.title: Achievement unlocks
FRIERENMOD-ACHIEVEMENTS.hover.desc: Enable Frieren achievements and slot-background unlocks. Collected backgrounds remain usable when disabled.
FRIERENMOD-BACK_LIBRARY.title: Achievements and slot backgrounds
FRIERENMOD-BACK_LIBRARY_OPEN.title: Browse and select
FRIERENMOD-ALLOW_OTHER_ACT_TWO_BOSSES.ho: When disabled, Frieren faces Aura in Act 2 and Spiegel in Act 3. In double-boss runs, Spiegel may appear first or second. Enable to restore mixed boss pools. Applies to new all-Frieren runs.
FRIERENMOD-CARD_RELIC_SOUNDS.title: Card and Relic Sounds
FRIERENMOD-CARD_RELIC_SOUNDS.hover.desc: Play the original sounds for Sleeping In, Blown Kiss, Ordinary Offensive Magic, and Mirrored Lotus Ring. Off by default. Does not affect music or achievement sounds.
